identity.affine_arithmetic: Arb encloses c0+exact_delta*v and alpha0+exact_delta*w before all fixed base weights
identity.parameter_arithmetic: First form complete exact center and direction scalar polynomials; then add the single p in [-eta,eta]. No independent raw-control parameter intervals are introduced.
identity.exact_delta_fraction_scope: The exact_delta_fraction field names the center only; all bounds cover the separately stated whole exact_parameter_interval.

balanced_variable: Z_sigma=|D|^-1/2 P_H X_sigma; D=-i partial_x, x=4theta
exact_same_cone_generator: i*sigma*epsilon/8 * |D|^-1/2 P_epsilon,N M_(Hsigma_prime*(kappa o Hsigma)) P_epsilon,N |D|^-1/2
exact_common_mean_identity: mean(Hsigma_prime*(kappa o Hsigma))=mean(kappa), independently of sigma
exact_first_phase: sigma/8*integral Hsigma_prime*(kappa o Hsigma) dr, the original full true phase function
full_off_diagonal_generator: |D|^-1/2 K_HH |D|^1/2 minus the four same-branch same-sign generators, with original PH locations
physical_source_units: The original scalar density f in physical dr, pulled to x=4theta; source norm L1(dr;HN^j). No weak residual is renamed.
source_budget_scope: Norm of the exact gauged forcing, not the solution of the remaining off-diagonal/head/mean time problem.
complete_low_history: all nonzero label modes abs(n)<N in both X components
alpha=<X_plus>=-<X_minus>, the actual mean zeta divided by two
c, the independent scalar height integration constant
exact_physical_reconstruction: u=m*w; z=y_plus+y_minus, zeta=y_plus-y_minus; y_sigma=(S_sigma_prime)*(X_sigma o S_sigma); p=sqrt(mu)*zeta-T*u
hard_cutoff_edge_counterexample: a=2cos(x), b=2sin(x): <e_N,[A_N(a),A_N(b)]e_N>=-2i/(N(N+1)); hence no uniform order-three claim after hard projection

gates.name: same physical density coefficient rather than native curvature kappa
complete field cover and all true real times retained
full mean and head locations are unchanged
actual high phase has a small finite third Sobolev comparison
